Name: Tomuto's Portraits
Author: yuuujam
Description:
if you download the main files, you need "ContentPatcher" and "Smapi" as pre-mod.
if you download the optional files, it doesn't need any pre-mod, you just unzip the "rar" into "StardewVally\Content\Portraits". Remember to back up original ".xnb"s.
下载主要文件的话，得先装smapi和contentpatcher，然后把它解压到mod文件夹里。
下载可选文件的话，把压缩包解压到游戏正确路径"StardewVally﻿\Content\Portraits"里，替换所有xnb后缀就完事。但是最好先备份原文件。
两个办法选其一就行。有啥问题可以在评论区说。齐先生，贝啼，蜗牛教授，熊，保安，这些我没画，偷个懒。

Downloads.Description:
if this file doesn't work, try the optional file.

◇ add the winter version of villagers' portraits.

◇ fix the error report for some png misnaming.

如果这个文件装上没反应，那不如去下载下面那个optional file。
增加了冬季服装，修复了一些错误命名和小问题。

unzip the zip in "\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits" , then replace the original ".xnb" with the downloaded ".xnb", "ContentPatcher" or "Smapi" is no longer needed. Remember to back up original files.

把xnb后缀解压到游戏正确路径里覆盖原文件就完事。记得备份原文件。

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
